authoring: Scripted native Blender geometry; no external provider or paid generation
coordinates: runtime X right Y up +Z into alcove, origin centered at entrance floor
landing: z=3.97..4.95; final tread ends at z=3.97
texture_source: Existing project 1024 px tileable PBR maps, deterministically resized to 512 px and packed in the source blend and GLB; base color sRGB, normal and ORM linear
reimport: Blender 5.2.3 GLB importer checks roots, sockets, bounds, triangle/material budgets, one horizontal face at each of nine former riser overlaps and six landing locations, and 36 vertical-face samples per flight. The previous GLB fails the vertical test due to coincident surfaces.
illumination: Visual sconces only; runtime owns lighting
bakes: Existing tileable PBR maps, no high-to-low bake or lightmap
approval: Geometry inspection, independent visual review and Quest Browser render checks passed. Owner headset playtest pending.
visual_review: Solid and textured renders distinguished repeated walnut marks from overlapping riser faces. Final geometry passed independent review. Quest Browser rendered this GLB on Quest 3 and crossed both flights. Two camera positions show the corrected descending threshold. Both door swings exposed the dark recess and both blackout captures contained only black pixels.
rail_contact: Per flight, 18 posts penetrate stringer axes by at least 0.039999 m; six landing feet and anchors overlap landing by at least 0.019999 m.
rear_door: Hinged leaf, pull and sign move with named DoorPivot. Pivot x=-0.59, z=4.915 at landing height; negative runtime Y yaw opens into the dark recess. HandleSocket is at x=0.44, z=4.775, landing+0.88.
door_clearance: Blender evaluated world-space BVH checks of all moving leaf meshes against the jambs, rear wall, lintel and recess at 5-degree increments from 5 through 75 degrees.
surface_contact: Each riser is a vertical face 3 mm behind its tread boundary (z=0.913+0.34i) without horizontal caps. Ascending supports begin 6 mm behind the boundary. Threshold ends z=0.91, treads span z=0.91+0.34i to 1.25+0.34i, and landing begins z=3.97.
preview_provenance: Blender 5.3.0 EEVEE, rendering the final packed stairwell.blend with both pivots rotated -55 degrees in memory. Preview-only camera and lights were added in memory; runtime supplies dynamic sign text and lighting.

geometry_uv_fingerprints.method: Blender 5.2.3 reimport, meshes ordered by object name, SHA-256 over little-endian float32 world-space vertices and loop UVs respectively
